headline_stat.name: fraction of units significantly cosine-tuned for reach direction (permutation p<0.01)

stated_limitation: Everything here comes from a single session of one animal. Unit-to-array identity is not recoverable from this NWB conversion, so no M1/PMd comparison is made. The decoding analysis is restricted to within-reach bins with speed above 100 mm/s, which is an easier regime than decoding across the whole session. The GLMs contain no spike-history or condition-invariant terms, so the absolute pseudo-R^2 values understate total explainable variance; only the relative comparison between nested models is intended to be read.

justification.dataset: MC_Maze (000128) macaque M1/PMd delayed reaching is the canonical dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct trial alignment, explicit unit/speed inclusion criteria, and corrected mm-scaling and un-recoverable array-identity noted honestly.
justification.analysis: Cosine fits with permutation controls, circular (Rayleigh) statistics, reach-grouped cross-validated nested Poisson GLMs, lag scan, and two decoders are all standard and correctly applied.
justification.correctness: Reported values reproduce from the committed code, are consistent with the figures, and rest on adequate sample sizes and proper controls.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show the effect with labeled units and sample sizes, and example units are ranked by cosine R^2 (the effect strength itself), not by a flattering unrelated criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence, the partial PD-preservation and GLM/gain-modulation nuances are framed carefully, and specific limitations of this session are stated plainly.
justification.verdict: This is publication-quality autonomous analysis with sound methods, reproducible numbers, and calibrated claims; accept.
